summary: Tested admin study-plans overview (API + /study-plans-overview page), new student per-course approved study-plan endpoint, and regression on /students/me/study-plan & /students/me/results. 11/12 backend tests pass; 1 security failure (scope bypass via department_id/faculty_id filter for scoped users). Frontend: dashboard card navigates to /study-plans-overview, stats (34/0/0/34) match API, all 3 filters work, faculty narrows department list, course row opens /manage-study-plan with correct course loaded. One logic/UX issue: courses with a saved-but-unapproved plan are labelled 'لا توجد خطة'.

critical.issue: Scope bypass: for scoped users (dean/dept head), passing ?department_id=<other dept> or ?faculty_id=<other faculty> OVERWRITES course_q['department_id'] set from _scope_department_ids, so out-of-scope courses are returned. Reproduced with Saeed (dept head, 4 courses unfiltered) -> ?department_id=<foreign dept> returned 1 foreign course. Fix: intersect the filter with dep_scope (e.g. if department_id not in dep_scope -> return empty/403; for faculty_id use set(fac_dept_ids) & set(dep_scope)), like faculty_board.py does with $and.

minor.issue: Status 'none' covers courses that HAVE a saved plan (weeks>0) which is simply not approved yet and has no pending_weeks (e.g. teacher's first save goes straight into weeks, not pending_weeks). E.g. 'دراسات حضرموت' (Hdha) has 3 weeks/6 topics but status none -> UI shows 'لا توجد خطة'. Suggest a 4th status like 'draft'/'unapproved' (plan exists, weeks>0, not approved) or count it as pending awaiting approval.

faculty_id filter only matches courses via department.faculty_id; courses carrying faculty_id directly but with no/foreign department are excluded (faculty_board uses $or on faculty_id too). Also no active-semester filter: lists courses from all semesters.

Ownership check (enrolled OR same dept+level) is looser than GET /students/me/courses (which filters by active semester and section, and only uses dept/level fallback when student has NO enrollments). Student can read approved plans of same dept/level courses from other semesters/sections. Low risk (read-only, approved content).

issues: Courses with an existing unapproved plan (shows 'N أسبوع · M موضوع' in green) have badge 'لا توجد خطة' -- contradictory
'بدون كلية / بدون قسم' group sorts first, above real faculties; consider placing it last
Admin menu item permissions [MANAGE_CURRICULUM, VIEW_CURRICULUM] while backend also allows manage_courses/view_courses -- minor mismatch

Distinguish 'plan exists but not approved' from 'no plan' in overview status (and UI badge/stat card)
Optional: include courses with direct faculty_id in faculty filter; consider active-semester filter; tighten student per-course ownership to match /students/me/courses
